goal: Deliver a harness-neutral Agent Image v0.1 protocol and toolchain with real Hermes, OpenClaw, DSH, and vHarness adapters; at least three P1 native restores; one Hermes-to-OpenClaw P2 migration; privacy-safe inspect, verify, diff, and redact; a restored trained-agent demonstration; and a third-party-extensible registry.
epoch_goal: Prove Hermes P1 against Hermes Agent v0.20.5 with source immutability, privacy safety, target recognition, and complete loss accounting.

HC-001.rationale: Core inspection and operation reports expose privacy and loss metadata without payload disclosure.

HC-002.rationale: Each adapter can emit typed opaque native layers.

HC-003.rationale: Inventory reconciliation is an adapter and integration gate.

HC-004.rationale: P0-P3 claims are stored and published only with matching gate evidence.

HC-005.rationale: Logical development, experience, evaluation, lineage, and native state remain distinct from starting profiles.

HC-006.rationale: Experience layers accept raw or referenced evidence without summary substitution.

HC-007.rationale: A dedicated trained-agent module owns the same-model fresh-restore gate.

HC-008.rationale: Habitat categories remain distinct and outside Core adapter semantics.

HC-009.rationale: Skill artifacts and development/experience state remain separate layers and proof obligations.

HO-001.rationale: Transport is isolated so OCI can be added later.

HO-002.rationale: Adapters depend on the SDK; Core never imports a harness.

HO-003.rationale: License selection remains a release decision.

HO-004.rationale: Context Body and consolidation can later use experience/native extensions.

HO-005.rationale: vHabitat and Team Image remain future artifacts without changing v0.1 scope.

HO-006.rationale: Current layer redaction provides evidence for later skill-preserving privacy stripping.

HO-007.rationale: Behavioral proof may test the hypothesis without encoding it in the schema.

protocol-core.purpose: Own the harness-neutral manifest, layers, privacy, provenance, loss, and claim semantics.

content-kernel.purpose: Own deterministic safe containers, validation, digests, and secret classification.

adapter-runtime.purpose: Own adapter discovery, inventories, capabilities, preflight, transactions, and operation reports.

hermes-p1.purpose: Own pinned Hermes detection, export mapping, native restore, and target validation.

formal-cli.purpose: Expose build, inspect, verify, redact, diff, restore, and migrate through formal services.

openclaw-p1.purpose: Own OpenClaw native restore and semantic surfaces.

dsh-p1.purpose: Own DSH ordered native composition and validation.

vharness-p1.purpose: Own vHarness mapping and native restore without governing Core.

hermes-openclaw-p2.purpose: Own the first semantic cross-harness migration and loss report.

trained-agent-proof.purpose: Own before/practice/after/fresh-restore behavioral evidence with an unchanged model.

registry-release.purpose: Own registry schema, evidence labels, release notes, and publication gates.

interfaces: Core owns containers, digests, manifests, privacy, and report validation; adapters never pack .aimg files.
Adapters expose read-only detection/inventory, export plans, native restore preflight/execution, semantic import preflight/execution, and capabilities.
Every operation report reconciles every input item to an acceptance-defined outcome.

implementation_noninterference.review_note: The plan was derived from the anchored horizon and normative documents. The bootstrap was consulted only for drift and later requalification audit.

scope_authority.review_note: The Hermes epoch advances the complete horizon and rejects no later adapter, Habitat, team, transport, or behavioral direction.
